title: brand.json
description: A site's brand settings, version 1. The build checks more than this schema can (files exist, tokens are defined, X fits its logo): cms/generator/brand.js is the authority, and this file is for editor autocompletion.

plainText.description: Plain text, shown as text on every page: no < or >, no straight double quote, and no control character such as a line break.

name.description: The brand's name. The site is called "<name> OS" (D9); never add OS here.

slug.description: Names the sender address (<slug>@bydefault.design) and the subdomain.

url.description: The site's canonical https address, no trailing slash.

hues.description: The hues the colour tools offer, in grid order. Each needs -dark, base, -light and -lighter tokens.

named.description: The brand's colours as Figma names them, so a tool shows the brand colour and never a text ink.

id.description: The name used in exported file names.

token.description: The custom property that holds it, without the dashes.

toolPairings.description: Every other tool's Pairs row. Defaults to pairings.

file.description: From the project root. Its viewBox is the glyph's own box, starting at x 0, so its width is X.

primary.description: The variant the clear-space rule is stated on. List it first.

spec.description: The clear-space rule as a Layout Spec, exported from the Layout Specs tool, drawn round every logo that has no spec of its own. Left out, the engine's Logo with clear space template.

clearSpace.description: Required on every mark. The build measures X off these paths of the file: the glyph's width in this logo's viewBox units.

paths.description: The glyph's path numbers in this file, from 1, in the order it draws them.

spec.description: This logo's own Layout Spec, when its rule is a placement rather than the brand's (an avatar on a circle).

close.description: The icon the page bar's close and the feedback dialog's close draw, by its name in the site's icon set. Defaults to close-large.

organisation.description: The owner named in app copy. Defaults to name.

website.description: The organisation's own public website, which can differ from the site's url. Defaults to url.

supportEmail.description: The address a reader writes to when a form can't send, named in the Ask for access form's error. Left out, the error names none.

locale.description: The spelling of the engine's own words: its guides, app pages and tool labels, and the page's lang. Left out, en-GB, as the engine is written. The site's own pages are never converted.

requestRoute.description: No longer read: Ask for access is the engine's /support.html on every site (phase D). Delete it.

turnstileSiteKey.description: The spam check's site key on the Ask for access page, given with the form service's address. Public. Left out, a signed-out reader's request is refused by the spam check.

communityLabel.description: What this deployment calls the community role and level: on the People page, the locked page, index tags, Settings levels and the invite email. The stored value stays community. Left out, Community.

defaultRole.description: The role People's Add person form starts on: one of the site's external roles when access.roles is set; community, team or guest when it is not. Never admin or owner. Left out, community (or the lowest role when the list has no community).

roles.description: The site's roles, highest first; the order is the rank. owner first, admin second, every internal role above every external one. Set the community label here, not in communityLabel. Left out, the five every site had before 8.8.0: owner, admin, team, community, guest.

key.description: Stored on each person and page, never changed. Not public, hidden, out or in.

label.description: What people see: People, the locked page, tags, the invite email.

internal.description: true for the site's own people, false for everyone outside.

frameOrigin.description: Where Ad Preview runs a pasted tag: the address of the frame Worker (wrangler.ad-frame.jsonc), on another site. Left out, the tag runs on this site in a sealed sandbox, which can't run tags that write into frames of their own. The build refuses an address on this site.

base.description: A permanent URL contract: sent signatures fetch their images from here forever.

email.description: The sign-in email's content. The look is the engine's, the same for every brand.

companyName.description: Who sends the email, in its footer. Defaults to wording.organisation.

logo.description: The logo as a PNG under assets/, 64px tall (shown at 32px), in one mid grey that reads on white and on near-black.

timeZone.description: The zone the email's time is written in. Defaults to Europe/London for en-GB and America/New_York for en-US.

switches.description: Reserved for phase B: the packages and apps a site switches on.
